backfills.methodology: Regional rates derived from sheet '1a Levelised DTC', Other Payment Method (Direct Debit), rows 14 to 27. Columns C/D are single-rate electricity nil/benchmark annual charges; G/H are gas nil/benchmark annual charges, in pounds excluding VAT. Unit rate = (benchmark - nil) * 1.05 * 100 / benchmark kWh (electricity 2500, gas 9500). Standing charge = nil * 1.05 * 100 / 365. Decimal arithmetic, rounded half up to two decimal places in pence. GB rates copied from Ofgem's July announcement, not averaged from rounded regional rates.
